newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian forex market closed for festivals.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian forex market closed for festivals.

text.p: The foreign exchange market in Malaysia remained closed on Monday for two major festivals.
The country's banking institutions were closed from Friday until Tuesday, February 11, for the twin celebrations of the Chinese Lunar New Year and the Moslem Eid al-Fitr.
The ringgit was last quoted at 2.4925/45 a dollar from Melbourne on Friday morning.
The ringgit is expected to trade in a wide 2.48-2.50 a dollar range in the near-term.
